description: Execution totals, token amounts, time trends, transaction costs and operational diagnostics for the selected environment. Counter observations include retries; they are not globally deduplicated order accounting. Period increases may miss the first exported nonzero sample. Missing data stays unknown.

spec.title: CPU usage by pod
spec.description: CPU seconds per wall second, expressed in CPU cores for each process. One fully used core is 1.0; this is not percent of a pod CPU limit.

spec.title: Memory by pod
spec.description: Resident and heap bytes per reporting process, scoped to solver exporters.

spec.title: Goroutines and file descriptors by pod
spec.description: Resource pressure per reporting process.

spec.title: RPC requests by role and outcome
spec.description: Logical RPC requests per second. Separate read and write roles so one path cannot hide the other.

spec.title: RPC errors by role and method · selected period
spec.description: Logical RPC errors separated by role, method and outcome.

spec.title: RPC attempts by endpoint · selected period
spec.description: Endpoint numbers are local to each process and role. Pod and scrape identity are retained so equally numbered endpoints from different deployments are not treated as one provider.

spec.title: RPC p95 latency by role
spec.description: Combined RPC histogram percentile per role, in seconds. Dashboard warning thresholds are operational defaults; adjust panel thresholds to the deployment SLA.

spec.title: RPC in-flight by role
spec.description: Current logical calls in flight for each role.

spec.title: RPC role last success
spec.description: Oldest last-success age among selected processes for each role. Inactivity is not itself proof of an outage. Age warnings use 1 / 5 minutes for freshness and 1 / 24 hours for activity unless otherwise configured.

spec.title: RPC calls · period
spec.description: Total logical RPC calls during the selected time range.

spec.title: RPC fallback overhead by role
spec.description: Endpoint attempts in excess of logical requests, per second and role.

spec.title: Transaction outcomes
spec.description: Terminal logical transaction counts by operation and outcome. Values aggregate all matching services.

spec.expr: sum by (label, outcome) (((sum by (namespace, job, instance, label, outcome) (increase(solver_bot_txmanager_requests_total{namespace="${namespace}"}[$__range])))) )

spec.title: Admission and in-flight
spec.description: Current accepted work plus selected-range pre-admission rejections. Values aggregate all matching services.

spec.expr: label_replace((sum by (label) ((sum by (namespace, job, instance, label) (solver_bot_txmanager_inflight{namespace="${namespace}"})) )), "signal", "In flight", "", "") or label_replace((sum by (label, reason) (((sum by (namespace, job, instance, label, reason) (increase(solver_bot_txmanager_admission_rejections_total{namespace="${namespace}"}[$__range])))) )), "signal", "Rejected", "", "")

not_actionable.text: Order not currently fillable or outside scope

spec.title: Lifecycle latency · selected period
spec.description: Combined histogram observations during the selected period. An idle short window does not erase earlier samples in this period. No latency samples means no percentile is available. Initial unobserved counter values cannot be recovered. Dashboard warning thresholds are operational defaults; adjust panel thresholds to the deployment SLA.

not_actionable.text: Order not currently fillable or outside scope

spec.title: Phase p95 · selected period
spec.description: Combined histogram observations during the selected period. An idle short window does not erase earlier samples in this period. No latency samples means no percentile is available. Initial unobserved counter values cannot be recovered. Dashboard warning thresholds are operational defaults; adjust panel thresholds to the deployment SLA.

not_actionable.text: Order not currently fillable or outside scope

spec.title: Reported gas · since process starts
spec.description: Raw current counters of reporting services since process starts. Includes the first observed nonzero value; includes preperiod history and excludes vanished services. Fees may be incomplete if a receipt did not provide effective gas price.

not_actionable.text: Order not currently fillable or outside scope

spec.title: Transaction fees · selected period
spec.description: Observed fee increases during the selected interval, in ETH and separated by transaction outcome. Initial nonzero values and receipts without effective gas price can be missed; zero is not proof of no spending.

not_actionable.text: Order not currently fillable or outside scope

spec.title: Replacements and cancellations
spec.description: Values aggregate all matching services.

spec.expr: sum by (label, kind) (((sum by (namespace, job, instance, label, kind) (increase(solver_bot_txmanager_replacements_total{namespace="${namespace}"}[$__range])))) )

not_actionable.text: Order not currently fillable or outside scope

spec.title: Sender balance history
spec.description: ETH balance per signer. Dashboard gas-budget defaults: red below 0.01 ETH, yellow below 0.05 ETH. Adjust these thresholds for the deployment gas budget.

spec.expr: max by (address) (max by (namespace, job, instance, address) ((solver_bot_txmanager_account_balance_wei{namespace="${namespace}"} / 1e18) * on (namespace, job, instance) group_left (address) (max by (namespace, job, instance, address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace="${namespace}"}))))

spec.title: RPC errors · period
spec.description: Logical RPC calls ending in an error during the selected time range.

spec.title: Pending nonce gap
spec.description: Pending nonce minus latest confirmed nonce, paired within each reporting process before grouping by signer. Values above zero represent pending nonces.

spec.title: Account refresh counts
spec.description: Refresh counts and retained snapshot age; failed refreshes do not zero balance or nonce gauges. Values aggregate all matching services.

spec.expr: sum by (outcome) (((sum by (namespace, job, instance, outcome) (increase(solver_bot_txmanager_account_refreshes_total{namespace="${namespace}"}[$__range])))) )

not_actionable.text: Order not currently fillable or outside scope

spec.title: Admission wait p95 · selected period
spec.description: Combined histogram observations during the selected period. An idle short window does not erase earlier samples in this period. No latency samples means no percentile is available. Initial unobserved counter values cannot be recovered. Dashboard warning thresholds are operational defaults; adjust panel thresholds to the deployment SLA.

not_actionable.text: Order not currently fillable or outside scope

spec.title: Account snapshot age
spec.description: Aggregate account snapshot age. Current state uses the latest samples; counters cover the selected time range. Age warnings use 1 / 5 minutes for freshness and 1 / 24 hours for activity unless otherwise configured.

spec.expr: clamp_min(time() - (min by (address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_last_successful_refresh_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}"} * on (namespace, job, instance) group_left (address) (max by (namespace, job, instance, address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace="${namespace}"}))) > 0), 0) or ((min by (address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_last_successful_refresh_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}"} * on (namespace, job, instance) group_left (address) (max by (namespace, job, instance, address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace="${namespace}"}))) == 0) - 1)

not_actionable.text: Order not currently fillable or outside scope

spec.description: Rejected observations caused by undeclared metric dimensions. Nonzero counts indicate a telemetry contract problem.
spec.title: Dropped metric observations
Exporter coverage
spec.description: Current scrape identities with build metadata and with solver membership. Exporters without solver metadata may run an older schema; their business panels cannot be inferred from build_info. These counts describe telemetry coverage, not service health.

spec.title: Reported builds
spec.description: Build versions currently reporting in this environment. Use alongside exporter coverage to identify an older metrics schema without infrastructure breakdowns.

spec.expr: label_replace(count by(version,commit)(solver_bot_build_info{namespace="${namespace}"} unless on(namespace,job,instance) solver_bot_solver_info{namespace="${namespace}"}), "metadata", "Missing", "", "") or label_replace(count by(version,commit)(solver_bot_build_info{namespace="${namespace}"} and on(namespace,job,instance) solver_bot_solver_info{namespace="${namespace}"}), "metadata", "Present", "", "")

spec.title: Completed operations · selected period
spec.description: Successful fills, redeemed requests and settled OEV bids, kept separate by operation. Redeemed requests are not transaction counts. Counts are observed operations during the selected period, including retries and separate service observations; stages are not a cohort conversion. Missing telemetry remains unknown. Fees are costs, not profit.

spec.title: Since last completed operation
spec.description: Age of the latest successful operation timestamp still visible in the selected period. No success observed means the timestamp is initialized to zero; missing telemetry is not converted to zero. Age warnings use 1 / 5 minutes for freshness and 1 / 24 hours for activity unless otherwise configured.

spec.expr: clamp_min(time() - ((max by(solver,event)(max_over_time(solver_bot_workflow_last_event_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",event=~"fill|redeem",outcome="success"}[$__range])) or max by(solver,event)(max_over_time(solver_bot_workflow_last_event_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="settled_success"}[$__range]))) > 0), 0) or (((max by(solver,event)(max_over_time(solver_bot_workflow_last_event_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",event=~"fill|redeem",outcome="success"}[$__range])) or max by(solver,event)(max_over_time(solver_bot_workflow_last_event_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="settled_success"}[$__range]))) == 0) - 1)

spec.title: RPC endpoint last success
spec.description: Last observed success for each process-local endpoint and role. An idle endpoint can have an old success or no success; compare with attempt outcomes before diagnosing an outage. Age warnings use 1 / 5 minutes for freshness and 1 / 24 hours for activity unless otherwise configured.

spec.title: Cumulative receipt fees · since process starts
spec.description: Current exporter counters, including preperiod fees and first nonzero samples. These are not selected-period totals; restarts reset them and vanished processes disappear.

spec.title: Completed operations over time
spec.description: Successful fill and redemption observations per second, kept separate by integration and event.

spec.title: Fill failures over time
spec.description: Fill failures and admission failures per second by integration.

spec.title: Transaction outcomes over time
spec.description: Terminal logical transaction observations per second by operation and outcome.

spec.title: Transaction fee rate
spec.description: Observed fees in ETH per second by operation and outcome. Initial nonzero samples can be missed.
